Container.Name: bambuddy-mcp
Container.Overview: Connect Paperclip or another MCP client to your existing Bambuddy instance over authenticated Streamable HTTP. MCP endpoint: http://NAS-IP:8091/mcp. No persistent appdata volume is required.

Config.Name: Bambuddy URL
Config.Description: LAN URL of your existing Bambuddy, for example http://192.168.1.10:8000. Do not use localhost.

Config.Name: Bambuddy API key
Config.Description: API key from Bambuddy Settings, if authentication is enabled.

Config.Name: MCP access token
Config.Description: Generate a separate random secret with openssl rand -hex 32. Enter it in Paperclip as the app key / bearer token.

Config.Name: Expose all tools
Config.Description: Optional: true lists every Bambuddy action directly. Refresh actions in Paperclip after changing this.
